judgments.rationale: The supplied descriptions classify EvoScientist, Autonomous Research Loops, and Heuresis as end-to-end or open-ended AI research frameworks spanning idea generation, experimentation, and broader research workflows, while RefLens, Evidence Coverage Evaluator, and CliVER are explicitly centered on citation/evidence/claim verification tasks. Within this six-paper reviewed set, the claimed broader-vs-verification-focused split is directly supported.
